main_measure.name: slope of next-day excess return on forecast (forecast > 0, pooled)

statistic.name: t of slope, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and check passes; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: top third minus bottom third mean next-day excess return (Welch t >= 1)

decided_by: The slope's t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Agitated bars are those whose regime is not the detector's 'chop' veto and a fall is a recorded raw component value below 0; cases are forecast > 0 bars with a next-day return inside the window; the slope is OLS with intercept, its t clustered by UTC day (CR1, G/(G-1)); thirds are the floor(n/3) lowest and highest forecasts after a stable sort.
